sections.title: Form and range
sections.text: A small chamomile relative known only from Gramvousa Island, Crete. It grows in coastal habitats; authoritative sources consulted did not give a dependable species-specific height or flower measurement.

sections.title: Conservation and uses
sections.text: The IUCN lists this island endemic as Critically Endangered. No food use or toxicity finding was verified; do not infer edibility from its daisy-like heads.

sections.title: Image note
sections.text: The plate's white-rayed, yellow-centred flower heads fit the species, but do not establish the plant's exact locality or a wild population.
